updateInstructions: Edit canonical records under root data/; never edit generated calculator or export files by hand.
Update data/sources before changing any row that depends on a new or revised study.
Preserve stable IDs, explicit system boundaries, source relationships, and collection order.
When total-system energy changes, update device fields and affected preset device selections together.
Record external comparisons and dispositions in data/review/external-comparisons.json so later feedback can be reconciled without losing prior reasoning.
Run npm run data:build, npm run data:export, and npm run data:verify before the Astro checks and build.
